Title: General availability: Azure SQL updates for late-January 2024

Body.Content:
In late-January 2024, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL:

  • The Azure SQL trigger is now available and uses SQL change tracking functionality to monitor a SQL table for changes. This provides developers a no code/low code change data stream capturing when data is created, updated, or deleted allowing for participation in modern application architectures.
